\item \textit{Notes:} Each block is a separate run of the same estimator,

$\boldsymbol\beta(\boldsymbol\delta)=
\widehat{\boldsymbol\beta}_{\mathrm{OLS}}
+(\mathbf X'\mathbf X/n)^{-1}(\mathbf k\odot\boldsymbol\delta_{\mathrm{raw}})
\widehat\sigma_r^2$ of Remark~\ref{rem:ols_identity}.
\item A gate status of `ok' obtained by raising the floor means the floor
removed a competing solution, not that the data identified one. The floor
is an assumption about how weak an instrument is acceptable and should be
stated as such; the interval in the last column is the summary that does
not depend on it.
\end{tablenotes}
